timeout.recommendation: Timeout depends on storage backend configuration (minio client has defaults)

retry.recommendation: Storage operations are within a DB transaction; retry at storage level could cause issues

circuit_breaker.recommendation: Low priority - avatar operations are infrequent

fallback.behavior: If avatar upload fails, transaction rolls back; repo keeps old avatar or generated identicon

idempotency.reason: Avatar upload is idempotent - same image produces same hash, re-upload is a no-op

blast_radius.impact: Users cannot update/delete repo avatars; repos still function normally with existing or generated avatars

findings.detail: DB update and storage write are in a transaction; if storage fails, DB rolls back
findings.recommendation: Current implementation handles this correctly with db.WithTx

non_atomic_operations: Old avatar file deletion after new avatar save - if delete fails, orphan file remains but operation succeeds
endpoint_resiliency.graceful_degradation: Falls back to generated identicon if no custom avatar

findings.detail: CreateOrUpdate pattern is inherently idempotent - safe to retry

endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: None - secrets are only consumed by action runners at task execution time
endpoint_resiliency.graceful_degradation: If secret creation fails, action runs will fail when trying to use the secret

rate_limiting.detail: No per-endpoint rate limiting for these endpoints
rate_limiting.recommendation: Low priority for secret/variable management endpoints

dead_letter_queues.detail: These endpoints are synchronous CRUD operations
